intro: Bow L-shape sofa brings comfort and utility together. With deep seating, hidden storage, and soft finish, it turns your living room into a space where life feels easier and cozier.

features.title: L-shape that expands your comfort
features.text: Wide layout lets you lounge freely, seat more people, and create a natural gathering space in your living room.

features.title: Integrated storage that saves space
features.text: Built-in compartments tuck away essentials like throws or games, keeping your room neat and functional.

features.title: Pocket-spring seats for resilient bounce
features.text: Cushions stay responsive and supportive, making long family evenings or solo naps equally comfortable.

features.title: Khaki fabric for understated charm
features.text: The soft khaki finish creates a warm, grounded look that complements both rustic tones and modern minimalism.

features.title: Crafted for durability and style
features.text: Quality construction ensures long-lasting use, while tailored finishes keep the sofa looking refined.

specs: Size (W x H x D, cm)
care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
name: Bow 6-Seater Fabric L Shape Sofa With Storage
